svg.title: 02 Prediction
svg.desc: Plot: one-dimensional Kalman predict step over position x from 0 to 14. The old belief is a narrow, tall Gaussian centered at x equals 4. An arrow labeled plus u equals 4 shifts it to the prediction, a shaded Gaussian centered at 8 with variance 2.5. The prediction is wider and lower than the old belief, showing that the motion command moves the mean while added process noise increases the uncertainty.
